items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with base / face / highlight / label decoration slots. Styled by a facet theme.
items.docs: The button has no look until a theme is active. This item also installs the base theme (themes/base.css): @import it from the CSS file that has @import "tailwindcss", and set data-theme="base" on an ancestor, e.g. <html>. For the skeuo theme: npx shadcn add @facet/theme-skeuo, @import themes/skeuo.css, set data-theme="skeuo". Needs a Base UI shadcn project (style base-*); it replaces your ui/button.tsx.

items.name: theme-base
items.title: Base theme
items.description: shadcn's nova style as a runtime theme, scoped to [data-theme="base"].
items.docs: Each theme needs two steps: @import its CSS from the CSS file that has @import "tailwindcss" (the path is where the file was installed), and set data-theme="base" on an ancestor, e.g. <html>.

items.name: theme-skeuo
items.title: Skeuo theme
items.description: Skeuomorphic theme scoped to [data-theme="skeuo"], tuned by --mat-* material tokens.
items.docs: Each theme needs two steps: @import its CSS from the CSS file that has @import "tailwindcss" (the path is where the file was installed), and set data-theme="skeuo" on an ancestor, e.g. <html>.
